title: Share to a chat from other apps
summary: Takes text, links, photos, videos and files shared from another app, lets the person pick a chat of the current account, then sends. Media go through upload-preview; text goes as a message.

kind.description: text: plain text or a web link, sent as typed. file: a photo, video or any other file, copied into the app while the provider's read grant is valid.

text.description: text only: the shared text or the link as text. Never fetched.

mimeType.description: file only: the provider's type, else from the file name.

name.description: The chat name, as in chat-list.

items.description: The items in provider order, at most 10.

droppedOverLimit.description: true when the share had more than 10 items: bipe_share_too_many shows, and only the first 10 stay.

chats.description: The joined chats of the current account in room list order (newest activity first), DMs and groups together.

query.description: The search text. Filters chats by name, ignoring case and accents.

message.description: The optional message. Starts with the shared text of text items. With files it becomes the caption of upload-preview.

isSending.description: true while a text message goes out.

phase.description: picking: the picker shows. signedOut: no account on this phone (bipe_share_signed_out); nothing is kept. nothingRead: no item could be read (bipe_share_nothing). failed: the room or the send failed (bipe_error_generic).

items.description: The items of the platform share.

receive.effect: Copies the items while the grant is valid, keeps the first 10, and opens the picker. With no account, phase signedOut and every copy is deleted.

pick.effect: With file items: opens upload-preview for that chat with the files and message as caption; its Send sends. With text items only: selects the chat, and send sends the message there.

send.effect: Text items only: sends message as one text message to the picked chat, then opens that chat. Off while message is blank or isSending.

cancel.effect: Closes without sending and deletes every copy.

notes: Sources: bipe-chat/bipe#769; Apple App Extension Programming Guide (Share) and shared app group containers; Android 'Receive simple data from other apps' and sharing shortcuts (ShortcutManagerCompat, share-target). No fork or Element source.
One share entry per platform (bipe-chat/bipe#740 reuses it for WhatsApp sticker import). Conferir no Bipe (pix-check-receive) stays next to it and keeps its own rules.

Types: text, web links, photos, videos and files of any type, at most 10 items in one share, like the attachment picker. Files go through upload-preview, so its limits, quality setting and metadata stripping apply.

iOS: the share extension shows two actions, bipe_share_send_to_chat and bipe_pix_check_title (Conferir no Bipe, text and images only). Send to a chat copies the items into the app group (a random one-use ID, protected files, out of backups, an atomic claim, deleted on expiry after 15 minutes, on claim or on cancel; no content in a URL), then shows bipe_share_handed_off and completes. The extension does not send: it has no SDK session. A share extension cannot open its app (no responder-chain workarounds), so the app takes the items on its next open. The extension reads the accountAvailable hint of pix-check-result: with no account it shows bipe_share_signed_out and keeps nothing.
iOS activation rule: text, web URL (1), images, movies and files, up to 10 each; the app caps the total at 10.

Android: MainActivity takes ACTION_SEND and ACTION_SEND_MULTIPLE for */* with CATEGORY_DEFAULT; PixCheckActivity keeps text/plain and image/*. Read EXTRA_TEXT and EXTRA_STREAM/ClipData, copy each content URI into the app cache at once, handle onNewIntent as well as cold launch, and consume the share once. With no account, a short message (bipe_share_signed_out) and nothing is kept.

Android sharing shortcuts: the 4 most recent chats of the current account are pushed as long-lived dynamic shortcuts with the share-target category, so the system share sheet offers them. A share through a shortcut opens the picker with that chat already picked. Shortcuts go when no account is left on the phone. Conversation shortcuts with avatars come with bipe-chat/bipe#771.
App lock (app-lock): the picker and upload-preview show only after the PIN. The items wait while the app is locked.
Only the current account sends. A share never goes to a chat without the person's tap on a chat and Send.
No shared text, file name or path goes to logs, analytics or the server before Send.
